US Singer D4vd to Face Murder Trial

US singer D4vd will stand trial for the murder of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. Her remains were discovered in September inside the trunk of a Tesla registered to the singer's address. A judge has ruled that the case will proceed to trial.
